crossRefs.note: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
“You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to…

translations.web: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
translations.bsb: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:
translations.kjv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done
translations.asv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:
